review_type: independent AI editorial review of 28 A1 items revised to replace words too hard for the first weeks of Dutch
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (Claude Sonnet), separate from the author agent; edits proposed in 103-proposed.json only.

meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context, separate from the author. The blind packet built from the author's original (hash 1ef8e614f5ec81880bbfe35c6c87fa5315720738485c389abbdc0e57ee3158ed) was read first and the findings were written into content/reviews/103-review.md before questions, keys, notes or sources were compared. After the two reviewer edits the packet was rebuilt from the exact proposed bytes; the hash recorded here is that final packet and the meaning findings are unchanged.

tone_balance.scope_note: These items replace published items with unchanged tone, so the program count does not change; four items keep their light humour (spoon music, odd shoes, dancing with a broom, dog with a hat). The coordinator checks the combined count.

edits.field: script[2].text, text, q1 evidence, q1 explanation
edits.before: Ja. Wilt u mijn sleutel hebben? En mijn planten water geven?
edits.after: Ja. U krijgt mijn sleutel. Wilt u mijn planten water geven?
edits.reason: "Wilt u mijn sleutel hebben?" asks whether the neighbour wants the key and reads oddly; "U krijgt mijn sleutel" states the hand-over and matches the q1 prompt "Wat krijgt de buurman van Ellen?" (kept as the author wrote it). The second request becomes its own question. Transcript rebuilt from the script; evidence verbatim. Same media as the author's version.

edits.before: Hoi Ravi! Mijn hond draagt mij hoed. Zo grappig!
edits.after: Hoi Ravi! Mijn hond draagt mij hoed. Zo leuk!
edits.reason: The word grappig was removed from the listening items but stayed in this learner-visible sample. Quotes are unaffected (the quote is the second sentence). No media.

checks.batch_check: npx tsx scripts/batch-check.ts content/batches/103-proposed.json: 28 items, 42 questions, no failures, no warnings (info only: all 28 ids are in the catalogue). Keys A 17, B 12, C 13; the author's earlier 40% key warning no longer appears.
checks.diff_against_sources: Each item was diffed field by field against the highest-numbered *-original.json that holds its id (083, 076, 075, 084, 078, 077, 086, 082, 081, 080). Only the planned words changed, plus the two reviewer edits. Question ids, keys and option shapes are unchanged; every images[].brief is byte-identical; changed alts (fietsfeest, docent-bord) describe the same picture.
checks.hard_words_gone: huismeester, ophalen, pinnen, rooster, bewaren, lekke band, beterschap, griep, studenten, passen, rit, grappig and every "noemt ... niet" no longer appear in any learner-visible field of the proposed file (the remaining "noemt" is the unrelated criterion "U noemt een andere dag" and "Noem een andere dag" in fietsfeest, plain A1 verbs).
checks.listening_text: Every listening transcript equals the script joined as Speaker: text lines; every evidence quote is verbatim in the final transcript.
checks.vocabulary: gek, hebben, krijgen, halen, leeg, band, koorts, mensen, zegt, kost, ziens are on config/a1-vocabulary.json (knownWord true).
checks.starters: The seven starters are unchanged, partial and aligned with the revised prompts (for example "Kom je ...?" and "Neem je ... mee?").
checks.answer_keys: Unchanged; each key is proven by verbatim evidence in the final text. Questions read together give no key away.
checks.spoken_naturalness: pass: Wat kost hij? / U krijgt mijn sleutel. Wilt u mijn planten water geven? / Goed. Tot ziens! / Wat gek! / Hoe betaalt Zara in de bus? read naturally aloud.
checks.full_final_source_read: pass: all fields of the proposed file were read after the edits.

media_notes.no_audio_change: 22 items: the 7 reading items, the 9 listening items with an explanation-only change (foto-werk, banaan-telefoon, eend-reis, bezem-feest, doos-oren, paraplu-werk, bloem-beker, kat-boeken, dokter-bellen) and the 6 writing items.

media_notes.voices: Roles unchanged from the sources. Use --keys with exactly the clips above.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
The A1 word gate is list-based; whether a plain word such as halen or gek is easy for every learner is an editorial judgment.
Regenerated audio needs its own transcription round trip.
